needs.CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL: your Atlassian site origin, such as https://example.atlassian.net - the host shown in the browser address bar while you are signed in to Confluence, with no /wiki path
needs.CONFLUENCE_EMAIL: the email address of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to; Confluence rejects the token without the matching address
needs.CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN: an Atlassian API token from id.atlassian.com, under Security > Create and manage API tokens > Create API token
